name: Pi-hole® Updatelists
tagline: A black hole for Internet advertisements. This is a fork of the Pi-hole® application that adds the ability to update the lists of blocked domains and regexes.
description: The Pi-hole® is a DNS sinkhole that protects your devices from unwanted content without installing any client-side software. This is a fork of the Pi-hole® application that adds the ability to update the lists of blocked domains and regexes.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Ftlconf webserver api password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-pihole-updatelists application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-pihole-updatelists
  # The `big-bear-pihole-updatelists` service definition
  big-bear-pihole-updatelists:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-pihole-updatelists
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: jacklul/pihole:2026.10.0@sha256:78ae32994996d599ec8739230b1b164ed0f8f052ec7d023570bd59467f478b58
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      TZ: "UTC"
      FTLCONF_webserver_api_password: ${SECRET_FTLCONF_WEBSERVER_API_PASSWORD}
      BLOCKLISTS_URL: "https://v.firebog.net/hosts/lists.php?type=tick"
      REGEX_BLACKLIST_URL: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mmotti/pihole-regex/master/regex.list"
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local /DATA/AppData/big-bear-pihole-updatelists/etc directory to /etc/pihole/ inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/etc:/etc/pihole/
      # Mounting the local /DATA/AppData/big-bear-pihole-updatelists/etc/pihole-updatelists directory to /etc/pihole-updatelists/ inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/etc/pihole-updatelists:/etc/pihole-updatelists/
      # Mounting the local /DATA/AppData/big-bear-pihole-updatelists/dnsmasq.d directory to /etc/dnsmasq.d inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/dnsmasq.d:/etc/dnsmasq.d/
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      - "67:67/udp"
      - "${APP_PORT}:80/tcp"
      - "10443:443/tcp"
    # Define the networks section
    networks:
      # Define the pihole-network
      - pihole-network
    # Capabilities to be added to the container
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
# Define the networks section
networks:
  # Define the pihole-network
  pihole-network:
    # Set the driver to bridge
    driver: bridge
